name: PanelBlaster
description: Crank up your GNOME panel! PanelBlaster turns the top bar into your personal ghettoblaster: play, search and organize radio stations and YouTube audio without leaving your desktop. Access a database of over 53,000 stations, queue up YouTube audio, and manage your favorites right from the tray. A revived fork of the seemingly unmaintained RadioKayra extension. IMPORTANT: Requires yt-dlp and GStreamer to be installed.
